question: Within a radius of 60 kilometers, where can I locate hotel heading toward Bunker Hill, IL from Money Museum, Chicago, IL?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Money Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Bunker Hill%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 ), search_path_buffer AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(sp.geometry, ep.geometry)::geography, 60000) AS buffered_geom FROM start_point sp, end_point ep ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, search_path_buffer spb WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, spb.buffered_geom);
